title: A · Rooftop marquee · $0.36
line: Sign: the 2K rooftop marquee, the real logo file lit on its blank panel, bulbs traced round the mark, the name in lights beside it. Calls: the AIs stand in the ring under the sign; each thinks (cloud, ?) until its call is in, then says it. Day head: the theatre's letter board, every letter a lit tile on the painted tracks. Undercard: small sign boxes, bulbs on their rims. Ground: dusk sky with searchlights.

title: B · Arena front · $0.07
line: Sign: the arena's marquee canopy. Calls: scorecards held up, back (hatched, ? in the AI's colour) until the call is in, then the printed front. Day head: a two-ink bill and, in the old dead space, the night's line-up as printed seals. Undercard: posters pasted on the brick. Ground: brick wall under a lamp.

title: C · Billboard over the city · $0.07
line: Sign: the floodlit billboard on the water-tower roof. Calls: a small bulb board under each AI, ? in unlit bulbs, then the call in green or red bulbs. Day head: the ring card held up, one drawn bell per bout. Undercard: lit shop windows across the street, awnings in each company's colour. Ground: night skyline.

title: D · The programme · $0.10
line: Sign: the 3D-modelled rooftop (seedream). Calls: a four-panel strip, one close-up per AI in its colour, thinking then shouting its call. Day head: the programme page, the day big and the numbered running order with marks. Undercard: Admit One tickets in each company's colour. Ground: velvet curtain.
